episodes.synopsis: The members of the Hero Club look forward to resuming their normal lives. And that means fun activities like band practice, karaoke, airsoft matches and camping trips!
episodes.title: Joyous Youth

episodes.synopsis: Back in Divine Era Year 298, Taisha gathers a group of candidates. One of them will become the next hero, and Mebuki will ensure that it will be her.
episodes.title: I Offer You My Everything

episodes.synopsis: The Sentinels have a dangerous task. Although Mebuki’s leadership has prevented fatalities, not everyone stays. Those who leave are replaced as if they were nothing but tools.
episodes.title: Smallest Joys

episodes.synopsis: The Sentinels do not have the powers of a hero, but they have each other. When the Vertex unexpectedly attack, Mebuki and her team face a battle unlike anything before.
episodes.title: Oracle

episodes.synopsis: Sonoko’s family possessed The Hero Records for generations. When she entrusts it to the Hero Club, they learn about the first heroes who defended humanity against the Vertex.
episodes.title: Brightness Unleashed

episodes.synopsis: People are cruel, a fact Chikage is all too well aware of.
episodes.title: Ease My Fears

episodes.synopsis: Two friends with different perspectives arrive at a crossroads, and conflict is inevitable. And when conflict occurs, consequences follow.
episodes.title: You Will Never Be Forgotten

episodes.synopsis: What does it mean to be a hero? Wakaba and Yuna are about to find out.
episodes.title: Eternal Vow

episodes.synopsis: Karin rages against the gods who cursed Yuuna, but they don’t answer when she issues a challenge from beyond the barrier. Instead, she finds the Sentinels and an old rival.
episodes.title: True Friendship

episodes.synopsis: The Heroes begin their final mission, but they weren’t the only ones fighting that day. While they battled the enemy, the Sentinels were holding the line.
episodes.title: Power Born of Adversity

episodes.synopsis: Tougou will do anything to save Yuuna, even if it means defying the will of the gods.
episodes.title: My Heart Burns

episodes.synopsis: The battle is over at long last. Now, the Hero Club must ask what comes next.
episodes.title: Everlasting Joy
